kit.live.label: Position
kit.live.reason.nosnapshot: To use your own game: on the play screen, choose a link in the card “Explain this position”.
kit.live.reason.variant: Only for the classic game: 2 players, neighbour jump, foreign triangles closed, 4 or 5 rows. On 5 rows the two network figures show their example only, because the network was trained on 4 rows.
kit.live.reason.rows5: Your game has 5 rows. The network was trained on 4 rows only and cannot read the larger houses of 15 cells, so this figure shows the example only.
kit.live.rows5: Your game has 5 rows. The engine plays it with `linear-r3`, whose weights were fitted on 4 rows with 10 pieces, and without the race table; only `dsumPhase` is rescaled to 10 pieces. The weights, the ratings of the moves and the strength levels were not recalibrated for 15 pieces.
kit.live.reason.over: The game is over, so there is no move left to explain.
kit.live.reason.nonet: This browser cannot run the net engine, so this figure shows the example only.
kit.live.status.loading: Loading the engine; the first time, the browser may download it …
kit.live.status.running: Computing in your browser: {done} of {total} steps done
kit.live.status.stopped: Stopped. The figure shows the example again.
kit.live.error.load: The engine could not start. Try again, or reload the page.
kit.live.error.offline: You are offline, and the engine files are not stored in this browser yet. Go online once, then try again.
kit.live.error.model: The network model could not be loaded, so nothing was computed.
kit.live.error.internal: The computation failed or its result did not pass a check, so the figure shows the example.
kit.live.error.unsupported: Nothing to compute: either the position has only one legal move, or the engine file in this browser is older than this page. In the second case, reload the page.
